parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all(); if(!items.length) throw new Error('No scene videos returned'); return [{json:{episode_id:items[0].json.episode_id,scene_videos:items.map(i=>i.json.video_file),subtitle_scenes:items.map(i=>({scene:i.json.scene,narration:i.json.narration,narration_en:i.json.narration_en,duration:Number(i.json.duration),voice_segments:i.json.voice_segments || []}))}}];
const status=$input.first().json;throw new Error('Kling image generation failed for generation_id '+status.generation_id+' (status: '+status.status+')');
